components.note: 土 (earth) — marks things to do with ground and soil, as in 地 ground, 坏 broken; 埋 is putting something into the earth.
里 (lǐ) — only a loose sound hint for mái today; mostly useful as the part that completes the shape.
口 (mouth) — marks speaking, shouting, eating and sounds, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 喊 is to shout.
咸 (xián) — sound hint is loose now (hǎn vs xián); same part sits in 减 jiǎn and 感 gǎn.
石 (stone) — marks stones and minerals, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break; magnets were first known as lodestone.
兹 (zī) — gives the sound, cí vs zī; 兹 also sounds out 滋 zī.
纟 (silk thread; traditional 糸) — marks thread, cloth and binding, as in 红 red, 给 give; 综 is arranging threads for weaving, then combining.
宗 (zōng) — same sound: 综 zōng. 宗 also sounds out 踪 zōng and 棕 zōng.
雨 (rain) — marks weather and moisture, as in 雪 snow, 雷 thunder, 露 dew; fog is water hanging in the air.
务 (wù) — same sound: 雾 wù. 务 also appears in 误 wù.
山 (mountain) — marks hills and heights, as in 岛 island, 峰 peak; 岗 first meant a ridge, later a post to stand guard on.
冈 (gāng) — close sound: 岗 gǎng. 冈 also sounds out 钢 gāng and 刚 gāng.
丸 (ball, pill) — a small round thing; the shape is a tiny bent figure, now just remember it as a pellet or pill, as in 药丸 pill.
页 (page, head) — marks things to do with the head or face, as in 顺, 领 lead; 颁 is bestowing and issuing publicly.
分 (fēn) — sound hint is loose now (bān vs fēn); 分 also hints at dividing out awards, as in 颁奖.
亻 (person) — marks people and their relationships, as in 你, 信 trust, 借 borrow; a debt is what a person owes.
责 (zé) — loose sound hint (zhài vs zé), but 责 also means duty, which fits owing a debt; same part in 积 jī.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 汤 soup; a hole as eroded by flowing water.
同 (tóng) — sound hint is loose (dòng vs tóng); 同 also sounds out 铜 tóng and 筒 tǒng.
穴 (cave) — roof 宀 over 八 (digging), a dug-out den. As radical 穴 appears in 空 empty, 窗 window, 穷 poor, all about hollows.
彳 (step) — marks walking and going, as in 行, 往 go toward, 后 behind; 役 is going out to serve or labor.
殳 (shū, weapon in hand) — marks striking or force, as in 设, 投; here it adds the sense of forced labor.
攵 (tap, action) — marks hitting or doing, as in 放 release, 改 change, 教 teach; 赦 is releasing someone from punishment.
赤 (chì) — loose sound hint (shè vs chì); 赤 also means bare, as in 赤手 bare-handed.
⺼ (flesh, from 肉) — marks body parts, as in 肚, 脸, 腿; 肋 is the ribs.
力 (lì) — close sound: 肋 lèi. 力 means strength, which also suits ribs as the body's frame.
钅 (metal; traditional 金) — marks metals and metal objects, as in 钟 bell/clock, 钱 money; 铃 is a small metal bell.
令 (lìng) — close sound: 铃 líng. 令 also sounds out 零 líng and 龄 líng.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and grass, as in 花 flower, 草 grass; 芒 is silvergrass, and by extension a sharp tip or ray, as in 光芒.
亡 (wáng) — only a loose hint (máng vs wáng); same part sounds out 忙 máng and 盲 máng.
土 (earth) — marks ground and soil; 坠 is falling down to the ground.
队 (duì) — loose sound hint (zhuì vs duì).
辛 (xīn, bitter/pungent) — 辛 itself means hot and pungent, so 辣 is spicy hot, as in 辛辣; 辛 also appears in 辩 and 辟.
束 (shù) — only a loose sound hint (là vs shù); same part in 刺 cì.
木 (tree) — marks trees and plants, as in 树, 林, 桃; 椒 is the pepper plant.
叔 (shū) — loose sound hint (jiāo vs shū); 椒 appears in 辣椒 chili and 胡椒 black pepper.
禾 (grain) — marks crops and grain, as in 种, 季; 秋 is the harvest season.
火 (fire) — grain plus fire: autumn, the season when crops ripen to harvest; 火 is also the only other part to remember.
戈 (dagger-axe) — a picture of an ancient weapon on a long pole. Marks weapons and fighting, as in 战 battle, 武 martial, 我.
大 (big, a person with arms spread) — below carved marks 丰刀: notches cut into tally sticks to record deals, hence contract, as in 契约 and agreement 默契.
尸 (body, crouching figure) — marks the body and posture, as in 尾 tail, 层, 居 reside; 屈 is bending the body.
罒 (net, 网 variant) — marks nets and covers, as in 罗, 罚; 罩 is a cover or a basket net, as in 胸罩 bra.
卓 (zhuó) — only a loose sound hint (zhào vs zhuó).
讠 (speech; traditional 言) — marks speaking and language, as in 说 say, 话 speech, 谎 lie; 诈 is cheating by words.
乍 (zhà) — same sound: 诈 zhà. 乍 also sounds out 炸 zhà and 榨 zhà.
饣 (food; traditional 食) — marks food and eating, as in 饭 meal, 饿 hungry; 饵 is bait or a cake.
耳 (ěr) — same sound: 饵 ěr; 耳 means ear.
山 (mountain) — marks mountains, as in 岛, 峰; 崭 first meant steep and high, then striking and brand new, as in 崭新.
斩 (zhǎn) — same sound: 崭 zhǎn. 斩 also sounds out 暂 zàn.
鸟 (bird) — marks birds, as in 鸡 chicken, 鹅 goose; 鹰 is the eagle or hawk.
见 (see) — marks looking and seeing, as in 观 watch, 现 appear; 览 is looking over something, as in 展览 exhibition.
雨 (rain) — a picture of drops falling from the sky 一 through a cloud. As radical it marks weather, as in 雪 snow, 雷 thunder, 雾 fog.
尸 (body) — marks the body and its posture; 履 is the body walking on shoes, then to tread and carry out, as in 履行.
復 (fù, return) — repeated steps going back and forth, so 履 is shoes worn by walkers, hence to tread or fulfil.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water, as in 海 sea, 河 river; 湾 is a bay, where water curves in.
弯 (wān) — same sound and also means curved: 湾 is a curve in the coast.
刂 (knife; 刀) — marks cutting, as in 刻 carve, 划 draw, 别 separate; 删 is cutting something out.
册 (cè, bound booklet) — cutting writing out of a book: delete, as in 删除.
日 (sun) — 昂 is rising and proud, as in 昂贵 expensive (price high); the sun rising up high is an easy memory aid.
卬 (áng) — same sound: 昂 áng. 卬 is the old form of 昂.
人 (person) — 禽 first meant to capture an animal; it now means birds, as in 家禽 poultry and 禽兽 beasts.
亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 信; 倍 is doubling, as in 加倍 and 两倍.
咅 (pǒu) — only a loose sound hint (bèi vs pǒu); same part sits in 部 bù and 培 péi.
虫 (insect) — marks insects and small creatures, as in 蚊 mosquito, 蜜 honey, 蛇 snake; 蚂 is in 蚂蚁 ant.
马 (mǎ) — same sound: 蚂 mǎ. 马 also sounds out 妈 mā and 骂 mà.
虫 (insect) — marks insects, as in 蚊 mosquito, 蛇 snake; 蚁 is the ant.
义 (yì) — close sound: 蚁 yǐ. 义 also sounds out 议 yì and 仪 yí.
臼 (jiù) — same sound: 舅 jiù. 臼 is a mortar; 舅 adds 男 (male) below: mother's brother.
男 (male) — 舅 is a male relative on the mother's side: your uncle, as in 舅舅.
纟 (silk thread; traditional 糸) — marks thread and tying, as in 给 give, 绑 bind; 缚 is tying up, as in 束缚.
尃 (fū) — close sound: 缚 fù. 尃 sounds out 博 bó, 簿 bù and 傅 fù.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 摊 is spreading out with the hands, then a stall.
难 (nán) — sound hint is loose (tān vs nán); same part in 瘫 tān, 滩 tān.
走 (walk) — marks walking and going, as in 起 rise, 超 surpass; 赴 is going toward a place, as in 赴约 keep an appointment.
卜 (bǔ) — only a loose sound hint (fù vs bǔ).
木 (tree) — marks trees, as in 树, 桃; 樱 is the cherry tree and its blossom.
婴 (yīng) — same sound: 樱 yīng. 婴 also sounds out 缨 yīng.
木 (tree) — marks trees, as in 树, 林; 桃 is the peach tree.
兆 (zhào) — loose sound hint (táo vs zhào); same part in 跳 tiào, 挑 tiāo and 逃 táo.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — marks feelings and mood, as in 怕 fear, 快 happy, 恨 hate; 忧 is worry and sadness.
尤 (yóu) — close sound: 忧 yōu vs yóu.
疒 (illness) — marks sickness, as in 病 ill, 疼 pain, 痛; 瘫 is paralysis, as in 瘫痪.
难 (nán) — only a loose sound hint (tān vs nán); same part in 摊 tān and 滩 tān.
疒 (illness) — marks sickness, as in 病, 疼; 痪 is numbness and paralysis, as in 瘫痪.
奂 (huàn) — same sound: 痪 huàn. 奂 also sounds out 换 huàn and 唤 huàn.
页 (head, page) — marks the head, as in 顺, 领, 额; 顽 is a hard head, stubborn, as in 顽固.
元 (yuán) — loose sound hint (wán vs yuán); same part in 完 wán.
